memo: Base: the pipeline embedded in sanpier (Saner Turhaner) 'Candidate-aware PubChem promotion 0.465' (frozen_0465.ipynb) = dmitriigluzdov 'CASMI 26: The Data Behind Spectra to Structures' v16 (public 0.464) + sanpier's candidate-specific rank-1 PubChem promotion (public 0.465), kernels/e3/base_f465.ipynb, unchanged except the cells marked ours. This version: f465 base + own COCONUT + ours_lfrag + ours_bt (ours): one-step biotransformation neighbours (sugar on / off, +-CH2, +SO3, +-O, +H2) of pool and training structures at each test mass join engine 2's pool, at most 40 per molecule. On 10-22 it cost -0.017 on a CPU kernel where ICEBERG reached only a third of the molecules, so the new isomers were ordered without the forward models; on the GPU they are ICEBERG / GLACIER-scored.
